episodes.title: Leaving the Label, Keeping the Good: A Hopeful Roadmap | Thinking Out Loud
episodes.description:
In this episode Kimberly talks with Audra Phelps — coach, former LDS member, and mom — about the messy, courageous work of disentangling faith, identity, and family life. Audra shares her journey leaving the Mormon Church, how she rebuilt community and purpose, and practical tools for emotional regulation, boundary-setting, and deciding what to keep or let go. Whether you’re questioning, staying, or already out, this conversation offers compassionate, middle-ground guidance and hope for creating a life aligned with your values.
